test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

HISTORY : HIOTSRY :: FEATURE : FEUTARE :: JOURNAL : ?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is: **First two, last two letters and middle letter are in same place while third and fifth letters are exchanging their position with each other.**

For, HISTORY : HIOTSRY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bd617620f62b8f15a54ee31d403fe33e48dc0d9c1284dbd4bec1d08fbce7690.png] 

For, FEATURE : FEUTARE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de42d4c2a6b0684709439621a89d9e3bd8d315292a48a3670ee54636b8ab62ec.png] 

Similarly, JOURNAL will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73863d0a266c381fd85de37edca50d22be689257ebeab70a4fb7d235c77d15ab.png] 

So, 'JOURNAL' will be written as 'JONRUAL'.

Hence, the correct answer is*** 'Option 3'.***
